interview:
**I won!** 🎉

The final screen shows "Le Chonk got the fish! 🐟" with the orange cat right next to the blue fish at the top-right corner of the board, in 18 moves.

Here's how it went: I started by entering the name "Chonk" and pressing Play. My first attempt ended in a loss when the guard dog caught the cat, so I pressed "Play again" and started over. On the second attempt, I navigated the cat across the bottom row to the right side, then worked my way up the board column by column, carefully avoiding the X-marked blocked squares and keeping distance from the pursuing dog. After several moves up and around obstacles, the cat finally reached the fish in the top-right corner — victory!
